title: Position size at fair value: distribution

coverage.note: Position size is fair_value, which is 0% null, so the pooled row uses every in-window position. The latest-quarter row uses the 1,439 positions dated 2026Q2. These are equal-weight distributional statistics of position size; the concentration exhibits below are fair-value-weighted.
